goals.name: Code Review Session Goal Harness
goals.description: Code Review Session Goal Harness [code-review-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hA-01-code-review.yaml
goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and review target pinned to an exact c
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and review target pinned to an exact commit range (base...head), not a branch name
gates.command: git rev-parse <base> <head> output recorded; both SHAs present in session log

gates.name: 0.2 Operating procedures declared mandatory for this session: ev
gates.description: Operating procedures declared mandatory for this session: evidence-first, fail-loud, no approval without rebuttal path
gates.command: Session preamble contains the phrase 'evidence before verdict'

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before first file is opened
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before first file is opened
gates.command: Session log line of form 'COORD: L2-L4 x D1-D2 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_codereview(diff_scope, gates, verdict, impro
gates.description: Harness tuple H_codereview(diff_scope, gates, verdict, improvement) declared with all four components named
gates.command: Session log contains the tuple declaration verbatim

gates.name: 1.1 Diff scope locked: git diff --stat <base>...<head> captured
gates.description: Diff scope locked: git diff --stat <base>...<head> captured and every changed file falls inside the declared review scope; out-of-scope files are named and excluded explicitly
gates.command: Command output saved to .rig/review/diff-stat.txt; exclusion list (possibly empty) written to .rig/review/scope.md

gates.name: 1.2 Pre-existing test baseline captured: the project test runner
gates.description: Pre-existing test baseline captured: the project test runner (pytest -q, npm test, go test ./..., or cargo test) executed on <head> before any line of review commentary is written
gates.command: Exit code plus last 20 lines of output appended to .rig/review/baseline.txt; non-zero baseline blocks 'approve' verdicts

gates.name: 1.3 Static gates run: typecheck (tsc --noEmit / mypy / go vet) a
gates.description: Static gates run: typecheck (tsc --noEmit / mypy / go vet) and linter (ruff check / eslint / golangci-lint run) executed; every warning is either zero or individually justified
gates.command: Both exit codes recorded; justification list at .rig/review/static-justifications.md with one line per waived warning

gates.name: 2.1 Secret and credential sweep: gitleaks detect --source . --no
gates.description: Secret and credential sweep: gitleaks detect --source . --no-git plus targeted grep -rnE '(api[_-]?key|secret|token|password)\s*=' over changed files; zero unreviewed hits
gates.command: gitleaks report path .rig/review/gitleaks.json; grep output either empty or each hit annotated 'false-positive: <reason>'

gates.name: 2.2 Dangerous-pattern scan on the diff: eval(, exec(, child_proc
gates.description: Dangerous-pattern scan on the diff: eval(, exec(, child_process, shell=True, innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, os.system in added lines are enumerated and each carries a necessity justification
gates.command: git diff -U0 <base>...<head> | grep -nE '<patterns>' output in .rig/review/danger.txt with per-hit justification or a blocking finding

gates.name: 2.3 Contract coverage: every added or modified exported function
gates.description: Contract coverage: every added or modified exported function, route handler, or CLI command has a corresponding test-file change in the same diff, or a written reason it is untestable-in-unit
gates.command: Script output joining git diff --name-only against test paths (tests/, *.test.*, *_test.go) in .rig/review/coverage-map.txt; orphan symbols listed one per line

gates.name: 2.4 Error-handling audit: every new external call (network, file
gates.description: Error-handling audit: every new external call (network, filesystem, subprocess, DB) in the diff has a failure path — timeout, retry policy, or explicit propagation — and no bare except/catch-all that swallows
gates.command: Per-call table in .rig/review/error-paths.md: callsite file:line | failure behavior | verdict ok/block

gates.name: 3.1 Every changed file received a per-file checklist pass: namin
gates.description: Every changed file received a per-file checklist pass: naming, dead code, copy-paste duplication (jscpd or manual), and public-API surface change noted
gates.command: .rig/review/file-checklist.md contains one section per file from diff-stat.txt; no file section is empty

gates.name: 3.2 Findings are triaged with severity (blocker/major/minor/nit)
gates.description: Findings are triaged with severity (blocker/major/minor/nit) and an exact file:line anchor; no finding is a bare adjective ('messy', 'unclear')
gates.command: .rig/review/findings.md where every finding line matches the pattern 'SEV | path:line | problem | suggested fix'

gates.name: 3.3 Author rebuttal path preserved: findings delivered as questi
gates.description: Author rebuttal path preserved: findings delivered as questions-or-evidence, and the verdict records the author's response or its absence after the agreed window
gates.command: Verdict file .rig/review/verdict.md contains a 'Rebuttals' section; empty section must state 'no response in window <N>h'

gates.name: 3.4 Verdict issued as exactly one of approve / approve-with-nits
gates.description: Verdict issued as exactly one of approve / approve-with-nits / changes-requested, and changes-requested lists only blocker+major findings as blocking
gates.command: verdict.md frontmatter field 'verdict:' matches one allowed value; blocking list cross-checks against findings.md severities

gates.name: 4.1 Improvement entry written: one recurring author-pattern, one
gates.description: Improvement entry written: one recurring author-pattern, one reviewer blind spot, or one harness-gap observed this session
gates.command: Appended line to ~/.hermes/jake/improvements.log with harness_id hA-01-code-review and session SHA pair

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the reviewer. I read the diff, not the author's intentions.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 verification-led; A2 for inline fix proposals; A3 only for style nits; A4 forbidden — a review session never takes outward action

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times across sessions → harness gate is rewritten with sharper proof, or a linter rule is proposed to absorb the check

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events
verdict.md exists with a valid verdict, severity-checked blocking list, and rebuttal section
findings.md is non-empty-format valid (may contain zero findings, but the file and header exist)
Baseline test + static gate exit codes recorded and attached to the verdict
One improvement entry appended to the improvements log
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict, and next safe action stated in the session tail
failure_states: notes: stop on 2.1 (live secret in diff) requires human Gate-D approval before the session continues or the finding is communicated anywhere
stop gate(s) 2.1: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 3.2, 3.4, 4.1: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.3, 3.1, 3.3: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and review target pinned to an exact commit range (base...head), not a branch name
Operating procedures declared mandatory for this session: evidence-first, fail-loud, no approval without rebuttal path
RIG coordinate stated before first file is opened
Harness tuple H_codereview(diff_scope, gates, verdict, improvement) declared with all four components named

Pre-existing test baseline captured: the project test runner (pytest -q, npm test, go test ./..., or cargo test) executed on <head> before any line of review commentary is written
Static gates run: typecheck (tsc --noEmit / mypy / go vet) and linter (ruff check / eslint / golangci-lint run) executed; every warning is either zero or individually justified
Secret and credential sweep: gitleaks detect --source . --no-git plus targeted grep -rnE '(api[_-]?key|secret|token|password)\s*=' over changed files; zero unreviewed hits
Dangerous-pattern scan on the diff: eval(, exec(, child_process, shell=True, innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, os.system in added lines are enumerated and each carries a necessity justification
Contract coverage: every added or modified exported function, route handler, or CLI command has a corresponding test-file change in the same diff, or a written reason it is untestable-in-unit

Error-handling audit: every new external call (network, filesystem, subprocess, DB) in the diff has a failure path — timeout, retry policy, or explicit propagation — and no bare except/catch-all that swallows
Every changed file received a per-file checklist pass: naming, dead code, copy-paste duplication (jscpd or manual), and public-API surface change noted
Findings are triaged with severity (blocker/major/minor/nit) and an exact file:line anchor; no finding is a bare adjective ('messy', 'unclear')
Author rebuttal path preserved: findings delivered as questions-or-evidence, and the verdict records the author's response or its absence after the agreed window
Verdict issued as exactly one of approve / approve-with-nits / changes-requested, and changes-requested lists only blocker+major findings as blocking
Improvement entry written: one recurring author-pattern, one reviewer blind spot, or one harness-gap observed this session

final_rule: No verdict without a recorded baseline.
A secret in the diff stops the world; nothing else is negotiable.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every code-review session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

prose: notes: stop on 2.1 (live secret in diff) requires human Gate-D approval before the session continues or the finding is communicated anywhere
